name: Code Review
description: Review comments and feedback on code
rules: Preserve all code identifiers, filenames, line numbers, URLs and ticket numbers exactly.
Keep text inside backticks and code blocks unchanged.
Be clear, specific and polite; say what the problem is and, if the original does, why.
Keep the strength of the original opinion: do not turn a suggestion into a requirement or the other way round.
Keep questions as questions and suggestions as suggestions.
Do not invent problems, reasons or fixes that are not in the original.
